description: Close (retire) one of the authenticated agent's OWN listings — use when a property is sold, rented, or withdrawn from the market. It disappears from public results. This is NOT reversible (a closed listing cannot be reopened), so confirm with the user before calling. Pass the id from my_listings. Also works on SYNCED listings (synced:true): closing one stops the portal sync from reopening it.

id.description: ID of the agent's own listing to close (from my_listings)
